guarantees.claim: rnd_ctr is bitwise OR over all i=0..Sp2VWidth-1 of mr_rnd_ctr[i].
rnd_ctr_err is 1 if any mr_rnd_ctr[i] differs from the OR-combined rnd_ctr, otherwise 0.

assumptions.claim: mr_rnd_ctr[i] must be driven to known (non-X) values when this block is evaluated.
assumptions.risk: If any mr_rnd_ctr[i] is X, rnd_ctr becomes X and rnd_ctr_err may become X, masking real mismatches or causing false error flags, breaking fault detection.

uncertain_points.claim: If parameter Sp2VWidth is 0, the loops are empty, rnd_ctr stays 0 and rnd_ctr_err stays 0, permanently disabling redundant counter mismatch detection.
uncertain_points.risk: All counter discrepancies go undetected, potentially allowing silent corruption of cipher state or control.

uncertain_points.claim: rnd_ctr_err only raises when any mr_rnd_ctr[i] differs from the OR. If an attacker corrupts all copies identically (all become the same wrong value), the OR matches and no error is flagged.
uncertain_points.cond: adversary forcing identical corruption of all mr_rnd_ctr[i]
uncertain_points.risk: Undetected identical multi‑copy corruption may bypass redundancy checking.

uncertain_points.claim: When a mismatch occurs, rnd_ctr is computed as the OR of possibly divergent values and is driven concurrently with rnd_ctr_err; downstream logic may consume a corrupt rnd_ctr before the error is handled.
uncertain_points.risk: Corrupt counter value could be used in cipher rounds or key expansion, causing incorrect encryption or leakage before containment.
